targets.expr: topk(100, sum by (geoip_country_name, geoip_city_name, geoip_location_latitude, geoip_location_longitude) (count_over_time({job="nginx_access", geoip_location_latitude!=""}[$__range])))

topk(200, sum by (geoip_country_name, entrypoint, route_runtime, server_name, upstream_addr) (count_over_time({job="nginx_access", entrypoint=~".+", route_runtime!="edge_or_redirect", geoip_country_name=~".+"}[$__range])))
